trips.title: Hervey Bay's Ultimate Small Group Whale Watch

notes: No image was downloaded or viewed; choices rely on file names, the site's own alt text and where each file sits on the page, so a person should look at the set. Logo: the only logo the site serves is the white header logo (LOGO_MAIN_white-1.svg), which will not show on a white background; the round site icon https://pacificwhale.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/cropped-PWF-HB-Icon.png is the alternative. Hero and gallery lead with the Ocean Defender with whales photo and the OZPWF and PACWHALE named shots on the video and photo gallery, charters and home pages. The whale watch and Seven Island trip pages have no photos of their own beyond a page banner, so those trips carry only the home page card image (1-1.png, 2-1.png and 3-1.png are PNG cards of unknown content; check they carry no printed text), and the first trip also carries gallery photos that the site labels with that trip's name or with Ocean Defender. Left out on purpose: photos whose alt text reads 'Hervey Bay images taken by PWF research team and Selket Kaufman' (IMG_8666.jpg, 0O9A6321-1.jpg, Bridge.jpg, IMG_4059.jpg, IMG_3147.jpg and Copyright-PWF_75.jpg in /wp-content/uploads/2026/08/, plus the charters banner IMG_0017_RET.jpg), because they carry a joint credit that names a photographer; a person who confirms they are the operator's own can add them. Also left out: the page banner OZ_IMG_Frazer-Island-Tourist-Guide_Cover-Image-2.jpg (guide cover), header_kgari.jpg and PWF_HerveyBay_WebBanner_B_02_011924-1-3.jpg (banners), the RES_5MT infographics, Natural-Cruise-Pac-Whale-AUS-tile-500x300-pixel.png (tile graphic), the 2022 Whale1 to Whale25 small PNG gallery tiles (file sizes suggest low resolution thumbnails), 2000-albino-whale-migaloo and images-1.jpg (video thumbnails with unclear ownership), K'gari tour photos (Lake-Mackenzie-1.jpg and the bus and Pinnacles photos belong to the separate Fraser Experience Tours land tours), team portraits, award and certification badges, partner logos, and the Instagram feed image. Videos: the site links no YouTube or Vimeo channel, so all six are embeds or files on its own pages. The home page loop (Vimeo 776074725) is an unlisted background video using hash baba60e71a and may need that hash to play; other background loops are Vimeo 1148175047 (Seven Island page) and 827143694 (Hervey Bay and Fraser Coast page). The mp4 trailer is about 48 MB. No bot check or captcha was met on pacificwhale.com.au.
